title: chore(console): refresh vendored objectui SPA to 1432efe8
body:
## What

Refresh the vendored `@object-ui/console` SPA pinned in `.objectui-sha` from `2b86379` → `1432efe8` (8 upstream commits) and ship the changeset that bumps `@objectstack/console` (minor).

## Upstream changes pulled in

- feat(studio): WYSIWYG form-layout designer in the Data pillar
- fix(fields): inline lookup editor shows the selected record's name; align inline lookup value resolution with the read cell
- fix(grid): BulkActionBar is now the single, i18n'd selection indicator; keep the bulk action bar inside the overflow-hidden container
- fix(studio): drop unused index param in ObjectFormDesigner container map (objectstack-ai/objectui#2143)

## Notes

- objectui `main` HEAD `39e9bdd` failed to build (`@object-ui/app-shell` tsc TS6133 unused `i` in `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`). Fixed upstream in objectstack-ai/objectui#2143; this pins to the merged commit `1432efe8`.
- Verified locally: `scripts/build-console.sh` → 35/35 turbo tasks green, dist 41560 KB, `check:console-sha` gate passes (dist stamp matches pin).
- `packages/console/dist` is gitignored and rebuilt in CI at publish.
